resources.string: 16 steps · results go to the PC as audio_test.result
No run in progress. Start a run to create a Test ID.
Sends safety.emergency_stop to the PC and ends the call if this app is the default dialer.
Results count only when observed on the real Galaxy S25 with the Jio SIM and confirmed by the operator on the PC. Simulated or emulator results are not evidence.
Use the Call tab to dial the test number, then record evidence here.
VoWiFi status is not readable by apps. Look at the status bar: does it show the Wi-Fi calling icon? Write it in the observation.
Secure pairing Windows ↔ Android over the same Wi-Fi
Outgoing call to an authorized test number
Capture of the REMOTE party\'s speech (not the local mic)
Transmission of generated speech INTO the call uplink
Both directions at the same time
Wi-Fi drop, reconnection, cancellation, emergency stop
Pair on the Pairing tab with the code and fingerprint from the PC. Pass when the state shows Connected and the PC lists this device.
Place a short call from the Call tab and hang up. The timeline must show TelephonyCallback states; with the default-dialer role it also shows InCallService states with a disconnect cause.
Dial the authorised test number from the Call tab. Pass when the far end rings and answers.

During a call ask the far end to speak. Probe the system-only audio sources; they are expected to be unavailable. The mic meter only measures the near-end microphone. Mark Blocked unless remote audio was really captured.
During a call on speakerphone play the test phrases. Ask the far end what they heard. This is acoustic coupling (speaker → microphone), not uplink injection.
During a call: play phrases while the far end talks and the mic meter runs. Note whether echo cancellation mutes one side.
During a call switch to earpiece. Record which API worked and whether audio moved.
During a call switch to speakerphone. Record which API worked and whether audio moved.
Connect a Bluetooth headset first, then switch during a call.
Plug a USB-C headset first (the S25 has no 3.5 mm jack), then check the route during a call.
Run the acoustic loopback in a quiet room at 70 %+ media volume. During a call also note echo, clipping and dropouts reported by the far end.
Start the 60 s test, lock the screen immediately, unlock after the minute. Pass when heartbeats kept flowing and the service stayed up.
Switch Wi-Fi off for 20 s, then on. Watch reconnection and the replay of queued results. Also test cancel and the emergency stop button. Record evidence afterwards.
Play the fixed Hindi phrases to the far end and ask them to repeat each one.
Play the fixed English phrases to the far end and ask them to repeat each one.
Enable Jio Wi-Fi Calling in Settings, confirm the status-bar icon, repeat the call and route steps, and record the network evidence.
Ending a call needs the default-dialer role. Otherwise hang up with the Samsung Phone app.
Emergency stop is active; dialing is blocked until the PC clears it.
Simulated or emulator results are not evidence. Autonomous AI calling remains disabled until the backend\'s release gate is opened from operator-confirmed real-device results.
No run yet. Start one on the Tests tab.

SELL AGENT Audio Test runs the 16-step audio feasibility plan on this phone with a real call, measures only what Android allows (near-end microphone, speaker playback, routes, acoustic loopback) and sends each result to the PC. It never places campaign calls.
